notes: Irregular board shapes: rectangles up to 19 per side, plus a 20x20 shape editor with cross/ring/L/U presets and JSON import/export; custom sound themes, where each of the four cues can use a built-in tone or your own audio file; the intro dialog is now collapsible with the changelog first; settings renamed to More; docs updated for Linux
notes_zh: 新增异型棋盘：长方形（长宽各 5-19）与自定义不规则形状（20×20 编辑器，十字/口字/L/U 预设，可导入导出）；新增自定义音效主题，四个音效位可各自选内置音色或传入自己的音频；引导弹窗改为可折叠、本版更新在前；设置页更名「更多」；文档补齐 Linux 平台
